name: 35mm Film
tagline: Grain, halation and honest color from classic analog stocks.
description: The analog look, without naming a single brand: warm color-negative portraits, tungsten cinema film with red halation, point-and-shoot flash, expired-film light leaks, pushed black and white, slide-film blues and diner booths. Native 2:3 frames that feel found in a shoebox.
